purpose: Central policy manifest for daily social content planning and future authorized publishing. This file does not authenticate accounts or publish content by itself.
account_directory_semantics: Treat entries as supplied URLs only. Do not count a URL as an authenticated account or publishing destination.

daily_content_program.output: One source-grounded post with a clear audience value and call to action.
One vertical short derived from the approved core idea; captions and accessible text required.
One short audio episode or a clearly labelled episode segment; use only authorized voice/audio.
One original storyboard/animation unit; label generated or illustrative media accurately.
One connected episode in a numbered series with continuity notes.

daily_calendar_ist.deliverable: topic, audience, source notes, intended outcome
short video, podcast segment, animated storyboard
rights, factuality, safety, captions, links, duplicate check
publish only to individually authorized destinations; otherwise retain as draft
per-destination result, post URL/ID, timestamp, errors, metrics when available

platform_routing.rule: Resolve account records by stable record identity only after an account is confirmed and its official API authorization is tested.
platform_routing.publish_condition: connection_status == AUTHORIZED_AND_TESTED AND platform_permissions explicitly allow the requested media/action AND content approval gate passes
platform_routing.unsupported_or_unavailable_api_behavior: Keep as draft and report the reason. Never claim a post was published.

quality_and_rights_gate: Preserve the source idea and its provenance; distinguish fact, opinion, philosophy, and hypothesis.
Check factual claims and cite primary sources where appropriate.
Use only media, music, images, likenesses, and voice recordings with documented usage rights and consent.
Run duplicate, spam, platform-policy, privacy, and accessibility checks.
Require human approval for the first live test on each destination and for sensitive/high-impact claims.
Do not infer scientific proof, endorsement, reach, or income from generated content or workflow success.

evidence_contract.draft_created: Record internal content ID, version, source references, and creation timestamp.
evidence_contract.published: Require platform response plus canonical post URL or post ID and timestamp.
evidence_contract.failed: Record destination, error code/message, retry count, and next action.
evidence_contract.engagement: Record only metrics actually returned by the platform.
evidence_contract.income: Count income only after payment-provider or bank evidence confirms receipt; views, clicks, catalog prices, and inquiries are not income.

security: Never commit OAuth access tokens, refresh tokens, passwords, webhook URLs, or payment secrets.
Store credentials only in the approved platform connection or encrypted secret store.
Use least-privilege scopes, destination allow-lists, idempotency keys, rate limits, and audit logs.
